recommended_zenodo_title: Cirsium capitulum phenomics across climatic gradients: V4 source-verified aggregate results and reproducibility code
description: Reproducibility package for a GEB Research Article candidate on photographic capitulum orientation, colour and outline in Cirsium. Contains verified aggregate tests (original 80 S1 and 128 S2), trait covariance tables, native/introduced colour coefficients, and exploratory climate-analogue multivariate resemblance summaries with their methodological and robustness context. The replay verifies archived numerical outputs but does not reproduce original photographs, observer-level metadata, protected coordinates or source-data statistical refitting.
